Since it was first published in Germany in 1983, The Discovery of Slowness has sold
more than a million copies and been translated into 15 languages. It has been adopted
as a manual and manifesto by European pressure groups and institutions representing
causes as diverse as sustainable development, management science and motoring
policy, even becoming involved in the debate about speed limits on German roads. The
